historical_references.reference: There is a popular mythological story in Hinduism about a demon named 'Tripurasura'. He was a powerful demon who created three cities, each made of gold, silver, and iron. Shiva, Vishnu, and Brahma joined forces to destroy the cities. The demon, knowing that he would be destroyed, constructed a powerful weapon called the 'Tripura Asura Shastra' which could destroy the universe. Shiva, using his third eye, destroyed this weapon which was named as 'Danger' in this context.

Another reference to the name 'Danger' can be found in the Puranic literature of Hinduism. In one of the Puranas, there is a story about a demon named 'Mahisha'. He was a powerful demon who was invincible except for being touched by a woman. Lord Shiva took the form of a beautiful woman named 'Mohini' to lure the demon and ultimately destroy him. During the battle, Lord Shiva in the form of Mohini, held a weapon of destruction named 'Maya-asana'. This weapon was personified as a demon named 'Maya-ruddha' or 'Danger' representing the illusion and delusion which led to Mahisha's downfall.
